description: The bar chart titled “Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment” visually compares the inference runtime (in seconds) of “Our Joint Framework” against four large language models (LLMs): ChatGPT, DeepSeek, LLaMA, and Claude. The vertical axis represents runtime in seconds, ranging from 0 to 400 with major gridlines at 50-second intervals. The horizontal axis lists the five models being compared. A legend in the top-left corner indicates that “Our Joint Framework” is represented by a dark green bar, while “LLM Models” are shown in light blue. Notably, only one green bar appears — for “Our Joint Framework” — with a runtime of 77 seconds, significantly lower than all LLMs. The LLMs’ runtimes are: ChatGPT at 190 seconds, DeepSeek at 365 seconds (the highest), LLaMA at 172 seconds, and Claude at 243 seconds. All LLM bars are light blue and labeled with their exact runtime values above each bar. The chart clearly illustrates that “Our Joint Framework” achieves substantially faster inference times compared to each of the individual LLMs in a streaming environment, suggesting greater efficiency for real-time applications such as fraud and concept drift detection in online conversations, as referenced in the associated paper.
